candidates.original_title: Of two minds forming and changing valence-inconsistent implicit and explicit attitudes
candidates.description: Briefly presented subliminal primes selectively influence implicit attitudes while explicit attitudes are influenced by supraliminal behavioral information, producing opposite implicit and explicit attitudes toward the same target.
candidates.citation_sentence: The goal of the first Experiment was to replicate the study of Rydell et al. (2006) as closely as possible.
candidates.notes: Experiment 1 used German translation of materials; prime recognition was above chance, contrary to the original; failed to replicate the implicit effect. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]
